name: First Peoples
blurb: Modern humans cross Sundaland and the Wallacea straits to Sahul; ancestors of the Papuans, Aboriginal Australians and the Orang Asli Semang are among the first.

name: Seafarers & Farmers
blurb: Austronesian speakers move out of Taiwan into the islands and across the Pacific and Indian Oceans; Austroasiatic farmers spread through the mainland and the Malay Peninsula; bronze drums and Bay of Bengal trade link the region.

name: Indic & Buddhist Polities
blurb: Rulers adopt Sanskrit, Hindu and Buddhist courtly forms through trade and pilgrimage: Funan, Srivijaya, Mataram, Angkor, Champa, Bagan, Majapahit's forerunners.

name: Age of Commerce & Islam
blurb: Majapahit, Melaka and the spice trade; Islam spreads along trade routes; Portuguese and Spanish arrive; port cities rival those of Europe.

name: Companies & Conquest
blurb: Chartered companies (VOC, EIC) build fortified ports and monopolies; slave trading feeds Batavia; Mataram, Makassar and Banten are subdued.

name: High Colonialism
blurb: Colonial states draw borders, extract through forced cultivation, plantations and mines, and move indentured labour across oceans.

name: War & Independence
blurb: Japanese occupation, revolutions and decolonisation; new nation-states contest borders and identities.

name: Nation-States & Development
blurb: Developmentalist regimes, transmigration, logging, palm oil, mining and tourism remake indigenous lands; adat and indigenous movements push back.
